Orestiada Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Orestiada, Greece

Demolished. Orestiada's Jewish community was a relatively young one by Greek standards — the town itself was only annexed by Greece in the 1920s, and this cemetery dates to the 20th century. The community numbered fewer than 200 people at its peak in 1940; after German occupation, Jews were ordered to report to the synagogue on May 4, 1943, and sent to the death camps, though some escaped to hide in the surrounding countryside. Only 3 Jews remained by 1945.
